Dataset & Population: NHANES 2011-2014, wrist-worn 80 Hz accelerometer data; 14,534 participants, aged 3+ years.
Method: CHAP wrist model combined with SWaN.
Estimate & Notes: 11.35 hours/day. Estimated waking sedentary time. Mean waking time was 17.10 hours/day after sleep exclusion.

Dataset & Population: NHANES 2003-2004; hip-worn ActiGraph data; 6,329 participants, aged 6+ years.
Estimate & Notes: 7.7 hours/day. Represented 54.9% of monitored time. Mean monitor wear time was 13.9 hours/day.

Method: Self-reported total sitting time from questionnaire.
Estimate & Notes: ~6.4 hours/day in adults; 8.2 hours/day in adolescents. Sitting time increased in both groups from 2001 onward.

Method: Self-reported sitting time on a typical day.
Estimate & Notes: ~6.4 hours/day. Excludes sleeping time; 25.7% of adults reported sitting for more than 8 hours per day.
